descriptionMarkdown:
Automatically slows down on the way to the broken planet or if Ammunition is low.

- Just connect the Input to your Hub and read Inventory, Speed, Startpoint and Destination.
- Connect the Output to your fuelpump and use the configuration of the one in the Blueprint.
- Adjust the values for your ship.

The current configuration travels on maxspeed to all Planets, incl. Aquilo, slows down to 200km/s from Aquilo to the Rim of the Solarsystem (and back) and to 100km/s on the way to the broken planet. If Ammo is below 1k (Rockets or Bullets) or 500 (Railgun) it slows down to 25km/s to restock.
title: Simple Speedcontrol for Promethiumship
